Each earlier line quotes the labels of its OWN interface; the Urdu does the same: det.visitInfo «سیاحوں کے لیے معلومات» and det.openMaps «گوگل میپس پر دیکھیں ↗» without its arrow, both compared by script with the approved `ur` block of src/i18n/ui.ts at this stage. Ruling N16, point 5, says quotation marks stand in three places only (an Arabic phrase kept as a name, a word cited as a word, the short name of a programme). A quoted label is closest to the second — words cited as the words on the screen — but it is a phrase, not a word, and the ruling's 'only' is explicit: a FOURTH use needs the judge. Without marks (C) the first label fuses with the sentence («سیاحوں کے لیے معلومات والے حصے میں» reads as 'in the section with information for tourists', which happens to work) but the second cannot be told from the sentence's own verb («… گوگل میپس پر دیکھیں کو دبائیں» is unreadable), so C must describe rather than quote, and then no longer tells the reader what to look for. NO NOUN FOR THE BUTTON: «… کو دبائیں» after a quoted label is how Urdu help texts say it, and the mark closes the label before «کو»; but the element is a link that opens another site, and 'press' suits a phone better than a desktop. B uses a loan the line has already admitted (termbase, P16-test: «لنک», in the approved «لنک کاپی ہو گیا»), names the thing, and its verb «کھولیں» is true on every device. 'Card' is «حصہ»: the label is the heading of that part of the page. The source's semicolon is a full stop (ruling N33). «گوگل میپس» is the termbase key; no Latin letter stands in the sentence. ‖ STAGE 7, ROUND 1: THE FIRST READER (his item 18, minor): "the quotation marks themselves were clear"; "on a phone one says «پر ٹیپ کریں» / «پر کلک کریں» rather than «کو دبائیں»". Both his verbs are loans with no termbase entry. He found the section and the link named without trouble. ‖ STAGE 7, ROUND 2: THE SECOND READER (his item 14, minor): '«کو دبائیں» for a link on a phone sounds like pressing a physical button'; his own verb is a loan with no entry. THE PROOF PASS (finding 4): rulings N40 and N72 of the termbase had already counted places for quotation marks beyond the three of ruling N16, point 5; by script the two quoted labels are byte for byte det.visitInfo and det.openMaps without its arrow. ‖ STAGE 7, ROUND 3: THE THIRD READER read the answer with «کا لنک کھولیں» and made no remark on it or on the marks. His item 2 (minor) is on the heading the answer quotes, «سیاحوں کے لیے معلومات», an interface string: 'the heading makes the card sound meant for foreign tourists'.

tm_pairs.en: Al-Asfar Lake is one of the twelve components inscribed as part of the Al-Ahsa Oasis site on the UNESCO World Heritage List: a rare expanse of water in the middle of the desert that has become a destination for anyone seeking quiet and a wide horizon. The lake is a stopover for migratory birds, which pass through twice a year on their journeys between north and south. Migratory birds stay here from the onset of winter until May. In 2019 the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced its conversion into a nature reserve. The lake lies northeast of the oasis palm groves. Its finest hour is sunset, when the surface of the water takes on a golden light — the favourite time of photographers and nature lovers.

tm_pairs.en: At the town of Salwa in Al-Ahsa's far south-east, by the Kingdom's land gateway to Qatar, Salwa Beach stretches along the Arabian Gulf about 150 kilometres from Hofuf. Salwa falls administratively under Al-Ahsa governorate; its sands are described as among the finest on the Gulf; the dunes of the Jafurah desert border it to the west, and the area is rich in birdlife. It is a well-known sea-fishing spot and a quiet destination for family sittings and shoreline walks, and the municipality has developed the beach and its park with shades, playgrounds, a walkway and outdoor fitness equipment.
tm_pairs.ur: الاحساء کے جنوب مشرقی سرے پر سلویٰ قصبہ ہے، جہاں خشکی کے راستے سعودی عرب کا دروازہ قطر کی طرف کھلتا ہے۔ یہیں، ہفوف سے تقریباً 150 کلومیٹر دور، سلویٰ کا ساحل سمندر خلیج کے کنارے پھیلا ہوا ہے۔ سلویٰ انتظامی طور پر الاحساء کے تحت آتا ہے۔ کہتے ہیں کہ اس کے ساحل کی ریت خلیج کی سب سے خوبصورت ریت میں شمار ہوتی ہے۔ مغربی جانب الجافورہ صحرا کے ریت کے ٹیلے اس ساحل سے آ ملتے ہیں، اور اس علاقے میں پرندوں کی بہتات ہے۔ سمندر میں مچھلی کے شکار کے لیے یہ ساحل مشہور ہے، اور خاندان کے ساتھ مل بیٹھنے اور کنارے کنارے چہل قدمی کے لیے ایک پرسکون مقام بھی ہے۔ بلدیہ نے اس ساحل اور اس کے باغ میں ترقیاتی کام کیے ہیں: یہاں سائبان، کھیل کے میدان اور چہل قدمی کا راستہ بنایا ہے، اور کھلی فضا میں ورزش کے آلات لگائے ہیں۔
